title: normalize_file leaves a leading '/' when the path starts with multiple slashes
property: the normalized path is relative, i.e. never starts with '/'
actual: '/a' (only one leading '/' is stripped, result is still absolute)
evidence: Docstring: 'Normalizes the file path to use the POSIX path separator, and make the paths relative (remove leading "/")'. Windows-style '\\\\server' also becomes '//server' -> '/server' after one strip, and normalizing the result again changes it, so the function is not idempotent.
